title: Xpulse 200T 4V Touring (Circuit Spec)
description: Representing Hero MotoCorp's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the Hero MotoCorp Xpulse 200T 4V Touring (Circuit Spec) is delivers all-weather long-haul versatility with long-travel suspension compliance. A 200cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
